html:
Andegerebenha is the name of an Aboriginal people and language of Central Australia, in the Northern Territory around the Hay River and Pituri Creek, east of Alice Springs toward the Simpson Desert.

Their speech is one of the Upper Arrernte languages. Neighbours on the map include the Alyawarr to the north and the Wangkangurru in the Simpson Desert. The language had only ten speakers in 1981 and none fluent by 2016. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: Andegerebenha is the name of an Aboriginal people and language of Central Australia, in the Northern Territory around the Hay River and Pituri Creek, east of Alice Springs toward the Simpson Desert.
